title: Cereal or granola bar (Kellogg's Nutri-Grain Cereal Bar)

content.title: About
content.content: Kellogg's Nutri‑Grain Cereal Bar is a ready‑to‑eat snack made from whole grains, dried fruit and a light sweet syrup. It is marketed as a quick breakfast or on‑the‑go snack, providing energy and a modest amount of protein.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Nutri‑Grain bars were first introduced in the early 1990s as part of Kellogg's fast‑breakfast lineup.
The formula combines whole grains (wheat, rice) with dried fruit, making it more nutritious than typical candy bars.
Each bar is individually sealed in a moisture‑proof wrapper for convenient portability.
The product is promoted as a "breakfast on the go" and targets both children and active adults.
In some markets, versions are fortified with additional vitamins and minerals such as iron and vitamin D.

items.title: Source of whole grains
items.content: Whole grains provide complex carbohydrates that release energy slowly, helping maintain satiety.

items.title: Modest protein content
items.content: Each bar supplies about 3–4 g of protein, supporting muscle repair after light activity.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Contains B1, B2 and B6 vitamins, which aid normal metabolism.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: Dried fruit and whole grains add fiber, supporting digestive health.

items.title: Convenient and portable
items.content: Individual packaging makes it easy to snack without preparation.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Bars contain added sugars, so intake should be limited for those monitoring blood glucose.

items.title: Allergens
items.content: May contain gluten, soy, and dairy, which are important for people with food allergies.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: One bar provides roughly 120–130 kcal; consider total daily calories when incorporating into the diet.

items.title: Sodium level
items.content: A small amount of salt is present, which may be a concern for individuals with hypertension.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The bar can be eaten straight from the wrapper, sliced into yogurt, oatmeal or smoothies, or taken as a convenient snack during travel, school or workouts.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, consume within 3–5 days for best quality.
